title: Some of Our AI Runs on a Desk, Not in the Cloud
description: We timed one task on our local AI and watched its network connections. Then we read what two cloud providers say happens to your text.
ogDescription: Our local AI answered in about two seconds and its only connection was the Mac to itself. Here's when we still use the cloud.
alt: Network connections of our local AI server during a request, showing only a connection from the Mac to itself
